created_local_note: This file was written BEFORE the jetP diff was applied and BEFORE any experiment session was launched. Provenance: file mtime must predate the session export's first data timestamp (checked in Phase 4).

deviation_disclosure.supersedes: the lever order in app_prereg_lr.json (which named rewScale 1.5 -> 3.0 next)
deviation_disclosure.rationale: the lr experiment's own evidence: dTimprove (0.07) and dwMaxFinal (300) were unmoved at 3x lr, and dTbaseline = 0 in every session so far — there is no temperature gradient for any reward-driven lever to amplify. Testing the gradient lever first is the cheaper diagnostic.
deviation_disclosure.verdict_log_correction: the lr verdict's 'below both baselines' wording is corrected: burst 29.4% (64/218) vs the 621 s baseline's 29.5% (71/241) is EQUAL within noise, not below. lr's outcome is recorded as NO EFFECT in this regime, not 'degraded'.

parameter_change.why_this_knob: no dedicated initial-dT parameter exists: particle spawn is symmetric by construction (fly_demon_3d.html:1940-1949, speeds 40-70 u/s both sides -> Tl=Tr -> dTbaseline=0 structurally). The ONLY asymmetry-generating mechanism is the left-side-only jet: slab band = 90+120*power, kick probability 0.3*power, kick speed 200+130*rand*(0.6+0.4*power) (jetFire, L7591-7614), auto-fired every 3.5 s at 0.8*jetP (L7848). jetP is therefore the single knob that sets the sides' temperature difference; T per side = sqrt(mean(v^2))/900 (tempStats L7800-7810).
parameter_change.expected_effect_on_dTbaseline: band 143->300 units (~19%->~39% of chamber), kick prob 0.165->0.3, faster kicks -> sustained dT in the ~0.03-0.07 range (modest, nonzero) instead of transient spikes decaying to <0.005
parameter_change.disclosed_confound: jetP also raises particle flux toward the gate (jet kicks are +x-directed, cos(an)~0.97-0.99) -> more crossings. Head metric is therefore a RATE (pooled good/total over burst windows), with crossing-rate-per-window reported alongside; burst windows are defined by crossing count to keep regime classification comparable across sessions.

keeper_rule_quote.rule: const ok = (selR !== null && selR >= 60 && tot >= 30 && p !== null && p < 0.05);
keeper_rule_quote.note: Quoted as-is, NOT amended by this pre-registration. selRecent = rolling-last-20-crossings selectivity.

session_plan.mode: same as all prior sessions (app boot defaults, fly-brain keeper; keeper row must read keeper=Demon, gateDriver=Fly brain)
session_plan.duration_note: >=800 s required, 900 preferred. Main CSV caps at 7200 rows = 720 s of 10 Hz rows (pre-existing cap, unchanged); events.csv and keeper stats cover the FULL session — all window analysis uses events.csv.
session_plan.export: schema v2.1 (meta.schema_version === 2.1), same benchmark-harness driver (verify_schema_v2_session.js pattern, detached)
session_plan.jetp_readback: the fly_log CSV jetP column must read 1 on every row (slider max); a session with jetP != 1 is INVALID and voids the experiment (counted as the one session, no reroll)

planned_analysis.windows: 60 s good-rate windows from events.csv crossing rows (field good) — identical read-only pipeline to all three prior sessions so all four are directly comparable
planned_analysis.burst_regime_definition: a 60 s window is BURST if it contains >= 25 crossings (same pre-registered definition as the lr prereg)
planned_analysis.head_metric: pooled burst-regime mean good-rate = pooled good / pooled n across burst windows
planned_analysis.burst_p: one-sided binomial (normal approximation, same estimator as the keeper rule) vs 50% at the burst pooled n
planned_analysis.rolling20_replay: rolling-last-20 selectivity over the full crossing sequence; report MAX and fraction of positions >= 60
planned_analysis.keeper_row: selRecentFinal, nGood, nBad, pOneSided, learningSuccess from keeper_performance.csv
planned_analysis.gradient_check: dTbaseline (keeper dTbaseline), dTvMax, dTimprove, dwMaxFinal — explicit check: did dTbaseline become > 0, and did dTimprove exceed 0.07 (the flat value from every session so far)?
planned_analysis.gate_sanity: gate_open/gate_close 1:1 pairing by gateId (open-at-save gate may legitimately be unclosed)

baselines.session_lr012: burst pooled 29.4% (64/218), p=1.0, dTbaseline 0, dTimprove 0.07, dwMax 300 — recorded as NO EFFECT (corrected per deviation_disclosure)

decision_rule.PASS: keeper rule met, OR burst-regime pooled mean >= 55% with p < 0.05 -> the dT gradient lever is sufficient; proceed to plan in verdict
decision_rule.PARTIAL: burst-regime pooled mean >= 52% with p < 0.05 -> clear shift above every baseline; proceed
decision_rule.NO_EFFECT: burst-regime pooled mean within the prior-session noise band, ~26-46% (i.e. > 46% and < 52% counts as above-baseline but not significant: recorded as NO-EFFECT-ABOVE-BASELINE with the p value reported), or inside 26-46% -> jetP alone insufficient in this regime
decision_rule.FAIL: unusable session — physics destabilized (NaN rows, crossing rate collapses to <5/min sustained), or good-rate far below all prior sessions (< 20%) -> report as unusable, lever rejected-in-this-regime

no_reroll_clause: EXACTLY ONE experiment session. Technical failures (crash, invalid export, jetP readback mismatch, infrastructure kill) may be re-attempted ONCE for recovery only — never to obtain a different behavioral outcome. No criterion changes after data exists. Bands are fixed now.
